name: Parliament of Uganda
notes: 12th Parliament (2026-2031), 529 members including 10 army representatives, as the Rio Times reports the Electoral Commission report of 2026; the Commission report itself was not found, and a second source (Daily Monitor) gives the same 372 NRM and 79 opposition. No member is named here: no supporter in the register sits in Parliament, so no seat is lit. Unlit seats mean nothing found yet, never opposition.
